summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a non-binding term sheet to acquire 33.3% of Gryphen Aircraft Industries for $5 million, with an option to increase to 53% within 24 months based on a €30 million valuation. The board’s recommendation is not stated; no advisors named. The transaction is subject to due diligence and definitive agreements. The investment targets the military UAV market, leveraging Gryphen’s existing aircraft platforms. Watch for execution of definitive agreements and milestone achievements; risk-arb centers on due diligence outcomes and regulatory clearance for this cross-border minority stake.
